_note: Single source of truth for which Claude model and effort each agent role uses. Read it through coolorbit/llm_roles.py (keys come from coolorbit/llm_keys.py). Change a role here, not in agent code. Prices: Claude API, USD per million tokens (cached 2026-10-06).

adjudicator.why: Highest-stakes, lowest-volume calls: settle referee disagreements and premise questions the rules and the premise checker can't decide.

referee_llm_audit.why: Audits every result's method for subtle errors; Opus 5.5 defaults to medium effort, so it is set explicitly.

premise_checker.why: Is the property measurable with this method/timescale? Escalates to the adjudicator when unsure.

arm_baseline.why: Claude Code sessions for comparison arms A and B (identical for both): a strong baseline makes the comparison credible.

scout.why: Proposes candidates (e.g. new alloy compositions); creative but routine, and checked downstream.

librarian.why: Looks up missing measured values with sources; judgment about sources, routine volume.

summarizer.why: Bulk summaries for the dashboard and logs; no scientific judgment. Haiku has no server-side fallback.
